title: Welcome to the log
body:
This is my local dev log. I jot down what I'm building, what I'm learning, and the occasional rabbit hole.

To add a permanent post, edit src/data/blog.json and add an object to this array. Posts you write from the composer below are saved in your browser only.

title: What I'm on right now
body: Going deeper on AI/ML — PyTorch, LLM apps, and wiring models into real product UIs. Also keeping the native C++/C# muscle alive on the side.
